source: GovInfo Congressional Record MODS granuleClass; per-section attribution measured by the docs/14 feasibility scout (2026-07-15)
rationale: A CREC day-package splits into granules by class. Allowlist member-authored/spoken classes; exclude Daily Digest (summaries, 0% member attribution). Extensions is built first (D1) — it is the press-release analogue.

EXTENSIONS.note: single-author member-inserted statements = the press-release analogue; E-lane built first

HOUSE.note: multi-speaker; carries an attribution-completeness flag; in-text 'Mr. X.' markers can raise attribution in a later pass

DAILYDIGEST.reason: summaries, 0% member attribution — excluded from every metric

amend_policy: additions/changes land as dated amendments in docs/15 §9 only
